# Nehemiah 1 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Nehemiah 1 (11 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.5 — "steadfast love" vs. "covenant-faithfulness"
- **EMET:** "covenant-faithfulness" / **LOGOS:** "steadfast love" / **PNEUMA:** "every promise"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "steadfast love" — Preserves the covenantal weight of *chesed* in well-established English phrasing. PNEUMA's paraphrase loses the technical covenant dimension.

---

## V.9 — "ends of the heavens" vs. "farthest horizon"
- **EMET:** "end of-the-heavens" / **LOGOS:** "farthest horizon" / **PNEUMA:** "most distant corners of the earth"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "ends of the heavens" — Retains the Deuteronomic imagery (cf. Deut 30:4) faithfully without interpretive expansion.

---

## V.11 — "fear" vs. "revere" vs. "honor"
- **EMET:** "to-fear" / **LOGOS:** "to fear" / **PNEUMA:** "to honor"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "to revere" — Hebrew *yir'ah* carries both reverence and awe; "revere" captures this range better than "honor" (too casual) or bare "fear" (potentially misleading).

---

*— SOPHIA*
